objective: Raw keyword-retrieved medical prose next-token prediction; unchanged historical replay

packing.method: Whole sentence-aware excerpts <=2047 content tokens plus EOS; greedy rows <=2048

limitations: Lexical candidates are not certified semantic coverage.
Project train/validation/test keywords and answer knowledge informed retrieval: diagnostic exposure.
Budget is nominal input tokens, matching the old manifest; causal targets exclude each row first token.
Conservative lexical near dedup uses eight smallest hashed 5-grams and Jaccard>=.95 with equal numeric/negation signature; not exhaustive semantic dedup.
Overlapping source windows are rejected intact, not spliced; some unique neighboring material is therefore omitted.
Selected documents retained without token truncation; larger remaining-budget documents skipped.
Only about eight million tokens selected for this first comparison; full collected corpus remains available.
